title: Heimserver-Retirement terminal abschließen
goal: Aktueller Livebefund: Infra PR #131 ist gemergt, Grabowskis aktive Fleet enthält keinen Heimserver mehr und Systemkatalog PR #149 veröffentlicht den retired-Lifecycle sowie aktuelle Primärquellenbindungen. Offen bleiben der revisionsgebundene Abschluss von Heimserver PR #44 auf Head 7e7d01ec610fbe872917b1ac65916103fed9fbc9 nach tatsächlich ausgeführter grüner GitHub-CI, die eigentumsgebundene Übernahme und Veröffentlichung des Leitstand-Lifecycle-Consumers sowie der abschließende Runtime-Readback. Historische Runtimebelege bleiben sichtbar, aber nicht autoritativ; Lifecycle und technische Gesundheit dürfen im Leitstand nicht vermischt werden.

acceptance.assertion: Task metadata preserves the originating live-register event id and source.
Any repository, merge or deployment effect remains review-before-effect and does not follow from the live event alone.
Infra PR #131 is merged and the current Grabowski Fleet contains no active Heimserver target.
Heimserver PR #44 is merged only after green GitHub-CI executed on the exact reviewed head and the post-merge main identity is read back.
Systemkatalog publishes Heimserver as retired with current source bindings while historical evidence remains explicitly non-authoritative.

The Leitstand lifecycle consumer is taken over only with explicit ownership evidence, reviewed on an exact diff, merged, deployed and verified without presenting retirement as a current health failure.
Fleet, SSH targets, runbooks, catalog and the deployed Leitstand agree that Heimserver has no active role, exposure or execution authority.

blockers.detail: The repository-contracts job for the exact Heimserver head failed before creating any steps; merge remains blocked until an actual green run exists.
The dirty ecosystem-lifecycle-freshness-v1 checkout has no current lease, task, process, retention or binding; read-only inspection does not authorize takeover.
